praise.use_for: Useful, helpful, exactly what I needed or was looking for; suits how the buyer plans.
Praise that the file runs quickly with no lag on the device.
Praise for roomy boxes, lines or note space.
Praise that pages are easy to print and come out crisp.
Praise for free updates or new yearly editions at no extra cost.
Praise that the files arrived quickly or were easy to download or access after buying.
Buyer says it is fun or enjoyable to fill in or use.

complaints.use_for: Links or pages inside the product lead to extra purchases, paywalls or forced email/subscription sign-ups.
Buyer links the purchase to spam, sold personal data, a virus or other security problems.
Seller required a rating or review before giving access to the file.

complaints.theme: Just a PDF, not a native device template
complaints.use_for: Loads as a plain PDF or document instead of a notebook template on the device; buyer expected native templates.
Time slots in 24-hour (military) or other format the buyer finds confusing.
Annoyed by repeated review requests or notifications asking for a rating.
Buyer says the product or shop uses stolen or plagiarized work.
Images or text the buyer finds sexist, racist or otherwise offensive.

complaints.theme: Just a flat PDF, not interactive
complaints.use_for: File acts like a plain image or PDF with no working digital features (no links, not set up for the note app).
Printing is tricky, pages print wrong, misaligned or not as they should.
Many near-duplicate or redundant pages, not enough variety.

complaints.theme: Physical order slow or never arrived
complaints.use_for: Printed or hard-copy order shipped late, got lost or never arrived.
Product comes as many separate files or downloads instead of one combined planner.
Buyer had to pay again for an updated or bug-fixed version.
Buyer says positive reviews are fake or rewarded with freebies.
Buyer didn't realise it was a printable file or didn't want to print and cut it themselves.
Buyer objects that covers, images or stickers are AI-generated rather than hand-made.
Buyer was charged more than once or more than the price shown.
Buyer got a different product or file than the one ordered.

complaints.theme: Slow or no delivery of files
complaints.use_for: Took a long time to get access, still waiting, or never received the files.
File is locked or restricted so the buyer can't share it with family or other users.

complaints.theme: Have to duplicate or add pages yourself
complaints.use_for: Only one copy of each page or no repeating dated pages, so the buyer must duplicate or build pages before using it.

wishes.theme: Other file formats (Google Docs, Word, Pages)
wishes.use_for: Wants the product in another file format or editor, such as Google Docs, Word or Apple Pages.
Wants pages or sections arranged in a sensible order so things are quick to find.
Wants a specific kind of page added to the product, such as to-do lists.
Wants higher-resolution stickers or images that stay sharp when enlarged.

wishes.theme: Stickers ready to copy and paste
wishes.use_for: Wants stickers or images that can be placed directly without tracing or extra steps.
Wants the daily schedule to start earlier or end later.
Wants the product in a language other than English, or without foreign-language text.

wishes.theme: Easier way to receive the files
wishes.use_for: Wishes the files were simpler to receive or download after buying.

wishes.theme: A video showing how it works
wishes.use_for: Wants a demo or video tutorial showing how to use the product.

wishes.theme: Times or details pre-filled on pages
wishes.use_for: Wants hours, dates or other fixed details already printed on pages so they need not be written each time.
Wants the product released again for next year or every year.
Wants book info and cover filled in automatically, e.g. from the ISBN.

wishes.theme: Easy move to a newer version
wishes.use_for: Wants to carry existing entries over when upgrading to a new edition.
Wants a lower price or to buy only the pages they need.

wishes.theme: A way to check items off
wishes.use_for: Wants checkboxes or a way to mark items done or paid each period.
Wants the journal to hold more book entries or review pages.
Wants pre-made stickers or elements (such as filled-in star ratings) to drop in instead of drawing them.
Would rather pay to have the planner printed and shipped.
Wants an undated version of a dated page or calendar.

wishes.theme: Crop or trim marks for printing
wishes.use_for: Wants cut, bleed or trim marks so printed pages fit the planner.

wishes.theme: App and PDF versions that match
wishes.use_for: Wants the companion app and the PDF/note-app version to share the same templates and stay in sync.
Wants ready layouts for A5 or half-sheet sizes, e.g. two pages per sheet with cut lines.
Wants to see previews of the actual pages before purchasing.
Wants more themes or style variations of the product.
Wants the file hyperlinked for digital use.
Wants fillable or typeable pages instead of handwriting only.
Wants each sheet or page as its own file instead of one long PDF to scroll through.
Wants more rewards, effects or features for gamified progress such as levelling up.
Wants concepts, diagrams or sections explained more clearly or in more depth.
Wants extra hyperlinks between views (e.g. daily back to weekly, month to week) for quicker navigation.
Wants more happening in gamified features, such as rewards or changes when leveling up.
